Go Travel Monthly Marketing Toolkit

December 2026

Market Yourself MondayWanderlust WednesdayFeatured Friday

Every post has a ready-to-post caption and one format: either a Canva graphic or a Reel. Tap Copy caption on any post, then paste it into your own post.

How to save a graphic or Reel

Android: Tap the Save image button under the graphic. It saves to the Download album in your Gallery or Photos app.

iPhone: Tap the Save image button under the graphic, then tap Save Image. It goes to your Photos.

Windows computer: Click the Save image button under the graphic. It saves to your Downloads folder.

Mac: Click the Save image button under the graphic. It saves to your Downloads folder. To put it in Photos instead, Control-click the graphic in Safari and choose Add Image to Photos.

Reels: Tap Open Reel on that day's post, then use the download option on the page that opens. Add the Reel to your post and paste in the caption with Copy caption.
